mapper.select: SELECT emp_id, IFNULL(dept_name,'') dept_name, emp_name, IFNULL(title_name,'') title_name, IFNULL(mobile_no,'') mobile_no, IFNULL(id,'') id, IFNULL(direct_no,'') direct_no, use_yn, DATE_FORMAT(reg_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') reg_date FROM tb_company_employee ORDER BY emp_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_company_employee (dept_name, emp_name, title_name, mobile_no, id, pw_no, direct_no, use_yn, reg_date) VALUES (#{dept_name}, #{emp_name}, #{title_name}, #{mobile_no}, #{id}, #{pw_no}, #{direct_no}, 'Y', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_name, title_name, mobile_no, id, direct_no FROM tb_company_employee WHERE id = #{id} AND pw_no = #{pw_no} AND use_yn = 'Y'
